definitions.explanation: Food stored or supplied for future use, especially for emergencies or expeditions.

examples.japanese: {食糧|しょくりょう}を{備蓄|びちく}しておく。
{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}が{深刻|しんこく}な{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: Food shortage is a serious problem.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}に{必要|ひつよう}な{食糧|しょくりょう}を{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I prepared the food supplies needed for mountain climbing.

notes:
Often used in contexts of emergency preparedness, expeditions, or large-scale food supply issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食糧|しょくりょう}{不足|ぶそく} (food shortage)
・{食糧|しょくりょう}{危機|きき} (food crisis)
・{食糧|しょくりょう}{援助|えんじょ} (food aid)
・{食糧|しょくりょう}を{備蓄|びちく}する (to stockpile food)
・{食糧|しょくりょう}{自給率|じきゅうりつ} (food self-sufficiency rate)

HOMOPHONE:
・{食料|しょくりょう} - same meaning, different kanji. {食糧|しょくりょう} is often used for staple foods like grains, while {食料|しょくりょう} is more general.

RELATED TERMS:
・{非常食|ひじょうしょく} (emergency food rations)
・{保存食|ほぞんしょく} (preserved/stored food)
